overview_summary: The Magnolia is a well-located 24-unit garden-style community in a supply-constrained Oakland submarket. In-place rents sit roughly 22% below market, offering a clear, executable path to value through a light-to-moderate renovation and management program.
rent_summary: Renovated comps in the immediate area are achieving meaningful premiums over The Magnolia's in-place rents, validating the renovation thesis.
sale_summary: Recent sub-50-unit trades in the submarket support pricing in the $300K-$340K per unit range at cap rates in the high-4s to low-5s.
location_summary: Walkable, transit-rich location near BART and a dense retail corridor — a leading driver of renter demand and rent durability.
contact_cta: Curious what The Magnolia could trade for today?
investment_highlights: ~22% embedded rent upside to market across the unit mix with no entitlement or major capital risk.
Classic-to-renovated spread of $400-$600/unit demonstrated by directly competing comps.
Irreplaceable infill location two blocks from the 19th St BART station.
Sub-50-unit scale appeals to the deepest, most competitive private-capital buyer pool.
Below-market expense load with opportunity to bill back utilities (RUBS).

developments: Uptown Oakland transit-oriented development continuing to add ground-floor retail and jobs.
Telegraph Ave streetscape and bike-lane improvements completed, boosting walkability.
Major employer expansions downtown supporting renter demand within walking distance.

regulations.title: Oakland Rent Adjustment Program
regulations.impact: Annual allowable increases are CPI-indexed; banking of prior increases is permitted. Underwrite organic growth conservatively, but vacancy decontrol preserves the renovation upside on turnover.

regulations.title: California AB 1482 (Statewide Cap)
regulations.impact: Caps increases at 5% + CPI (max 10%) on covered units. Provides a predictable growth floor and applies broadly across competing product.

regulations.title: Just Cause Eviction
regulations.impact: Relocation assistance may apply for owner move-in or substantial rehab. Factor turnover timing and relocation costs into any aggressive reposition plan.

regulations.title: Seismic / Soft-Story Ordinance
regulations.impact: Confirm the property's soft-story retrofit status; completed retrofits are a marketing positive and de-risk the asset for buyers.
